decisionContract: Round calibrated probabilities to integer billionths (floor(p*scale+0.5)) for policy selection/comparison only; retain full precision scores and unrounded trees.
selection: Minimize the previously declared 10/1/0.25 experimental cost on the policy partition, subject to whole-score ties and the union of mandatory rules within budget. No test selection.
uncertainty: OOD and conformal are displayed, not independent mandatory review gates. OOD remains a predictor input. All original full-policy artifacts remain unchanged.
runtimeSelection: First seed in the existing engineering plan, fixed before this policy evaluation; not the best test seed.
scope: Default Admin advisory display; shadow with respect to the existing Oracle verification and financial protocol. No automatic on-chain promotion.
limitations: Constructed action labels, not natural-fraud probabilities
30% is a validation comparison target, not a runtime capacity guarantee
New policy is exploratory after prior results
Registry history is not evidence of actually rendered services
